messages:
sophie.sales: Hey team — ACME asked for a hosted API key for a 1-week POC. Need: 1) short-lived key (7 days) 2) IP allowlist to 52.12.34.56/32 3) clear revocation & audit steps for their security questionnaire. Can eng/security provision and confirm?

jamal.eng: Yep. We can create a short-lived key from the Console or via the Keys API. For POCs we typically issue a scoped key with expires_at and allowed_ips. Max POC TTL is 30 days by policy, so 7 days is fine.

ida.security: Quick ask — where do audit logs appear and retention? Also need assurance key rotation/revocation is immediate and logged.

jamal.eng: Audit logs show up in the Console activity feed + the customer audit export. Default retention is 90 days for hosted; enterprise tenants can request longer retention. Revocation is immediate (revoke flag flips and token is invalidated). All actions (create/rotate/revoke) emit audit events with actor and IP.

jamal.eng: If you want to do it via API, here's the sample to create a key (replace placeholders):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{\n    "name":"acme-poc-temp",\n    "expires_at":"2026-03-28T12:00:00Z",\n    "allowed_ips":["52.12.34.56/32"],\n    "scopes":["inference:generate"]\n  }'
```

jamal.eng: To rotate later you can call `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate` or create a rotation job. For immediate revocation use `DELETE /v1/keys/{key_id}` or toggle revoke in Console.

sophie.sales: Can you create it and return the masked token+key_id so I can send to ACME? Also please put the expiration at 7 days from today and add the IP.

support-bot: Key creation request acknowledged. Creating key...

jamal.eng: Done — created scoped key for ACME. Key ID: kid_8b7f3c. Masked token (send this to customer): sk-****7a9b. Expiry: 2026-03-28T12:00:00Z. Allowed IPs: [52.12.34.56/32]. Audit event: evt_20260321_001 recorded.

ida.security: Thanks. Can we also schedule an automatic rotate job at day 3 for extra safety? Would prefer automatic rotation over manual.

jamal.eng: Yes — we can set a rotation job. Example API to create a cron-based rotation job: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rotation-jobs \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{\n    "key_id":"kid_8b7f3c",\n    "schedule":"@daily",\n    "max_runs":1\n  }'
```

jamal.eng: For POC we usually do a single rotate at day 3 (create new key, email token, revoke old). I can set that up and note it in the audit entry.

sophie.sales: Please set rotate at day 3 and add a note to the POC ticket that rotation will occur automatically. I'll pass the masked token to ACME and include the allowed IP.

jamal.eng: Rotation job scheduled for 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z. I added comment to POC ticket and linked audit evt_20260321_001 -> rot_20260324_01.

ida.security: For the questionnaire, add these details: audit log location, retention (90d), revocation flows (Console/API/DELETE), and KMS note (hosted uses Redwood KMS; enterprise can bring-key via KMS integration). That's enough for now.

sophie.sales: Perfect — I'll close the POC onboarding checklist and send an internal note to ACME. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
